description_en: Retrieves execution records of scheduled tasks
description_zh: 获取定时任务执行记录
name: GetScheduledTaskExecutionRecords

parameters.help_en: The ID of the effective tenant
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: 1. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 200
parameters.help_zh: 分页数。默认值：1，最小值：1，最大值：200
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the collaboration group to which the task belongs (such as cg_101). If specified, a group space task is created (the caller must be a valid group member). If left empty, a personal task is created
parameters.help_zh: 所属协作群组 ID（如 cg_101）；传入时创建群空间任务（调用者需为有效群成员），为空创建个人任务
parameters.name: collaboration_group_id

parameters.help_en: Filters by a single task ID. If not specified, execution records of all visible tasks are returned
parameters.help_zh: 按单个任务预筛选；不传时返回全部可见任务的执行记录
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
Filters by execution status (lowercase). Valid values:
pending: queued.
running: in progress.
success: succeeded.
failed: failed.
timeout: timed out.
cancelled: terminated.

If not specified, no status filter is applied. If specified, future planned items are no longer generated
parameters.help_zh: 执行状态筛选（小写）：pending(排队中)/running(执行中)/success(成功)/failed(失败)/timeout(超时)/cancelled(已终止)；不传表示不筛；传入时不再生成未来计划项
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: Filters by initiator (platform user ID). The scope is the executor of the record (manual execution = the person who triggered it, automatic execution = the task creator). To view only tasks initiated by yourself, pass the current user ID
parameters.help_zh: 按发起人筛选（平台用户 ID）；口径 = 记录的执行人（手动执行 = 触发人，自动执行 = 任务创建人）；只看自己发起的传当前用户 ID
parameters.name: initiator_user_id
